1.evidence_source: The BAS, which measures aspects of positive body image, is a 13-item scale that has been shown to have a unidimensional structure when completed by Western women (Avalos et al., 2005; Swami, Stieger, Haubner, & Voracek, 2008), with good test–retest reliability (Avalos et al., 2005) and good construct and discriminant validity (Avalos et al., 2005; Swami, Stieger, et al., 2008). All items were rated on a 5-point Likert-type scale (1 = Never, 5= Always) and responses on all 13 items were averaged to obtain an overall BAS score (higher scores reflected greater body appreciation). Cronbach's alpha for this scale was .90.
